BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-2, Neighborhood Shopping District and B1-3, Neighborhood
Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-H in the area bounded by

A line 132.90 feet North of and parallel to West Berwyn Avene; North Damen Avenue; A line
82.90 feet North of and parallel to West Berwyn Avenue; And a public alley next West of and
parallel to North Damen Avenue,

to those ofa B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

COMMON ADDRESS OF PROPERTY: 5308 — 5310 N. DAMEN AVE.
